title: Choosing a Course
transcript:
Student: Professor Ortiz, I'm trying to decide between your statistics seminar and the intro coding course next term.
Professor: Both are useful. What are you hoping to do after graduation?
Student: Probably something in public health research.
Professor: Then statistics will come up constantly. But honestly, most research teams expect some coding now, too.
Student: So you're saying I should take both?
Professor: If your schedule allows it. If not, take coding first. Statistics makes more sense once you can run your own analyses.
Student: Huh, I hadn't thought of it that way.
